newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: JCI raises interim shr, offers scrip div.
newsitem.headline: JCI raises interim shr, offers scrip div.

text.p: NOTE - JCI Ltd said it would offer capitalisation shares to shareholders who elected to receive them. Shareholders could elect to receive a cash dividend instead. The number of new shares would be determined as the ratio that 27 cents bears to the weighted average traded price of JCI Ltd shares on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on May 8.

JCI said that the purpose of the capitalisation award was to enable JCI to minimise its borrowings and increase its flexibility to respond to new business projects and investments which were critical to the group's strategy.
The company said that the exceptional item of 79 million rand included profit of 94 million rand on the sale of the remaining portion of JCI's investment in De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd.
